'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Adam Beauchamp LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Beauchamp]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''C-Banks''' / username '''Umpass'''. Communing (V) start.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing|Communing (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Umpass
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
